descriptions.sol35a_placement_dispatch_8008bf28: Look up the original placement type, retain the returned interface in a four-byte scoped handle, copy the packet vectors at +8/+20 into separate call-lifetime temporaries, synchronously set target and offset, register using receiver+20, and release the held interface. Const-reference setter parameters have the observed PPC32 pointer ABI; the original setters copy three words without retaining their source.
